messages:
emily: Opening thread for my PR that shifts console observability examples to metrics_v2. Found three small but blocking issues in the presets/heatmap example: a 404 link, the legend rendering expects `cost_aggregation: sum` but semantics changed, and tracehook drops empty trace_key.
ryan: drop the PR link pls when ready, I'll take the redirect.
emily: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5011 - includes example YAML and migration note. CI failed on examples job: renderer error: 'legend key not found' for heatmap.
tia: ack. The legend change was intentional (we renamed `cost_aggregation` -> `cost_mode` and values changed). Suggest we update the sample to `cost_mode: normalized` and add a short comment in the example explaining why.
ryan: for the 404, current link points to https://old-console.redwood.ai/playground - replace with https://console.redwood.ai/playground and I'll file infra redirect REDW-1206.
ci-bot: examples pipeline: TypeError: trace_key must be str, got None.
emily: repro YAML snippet in PR has `tracehook: { trace_key: null, span_sampling: true }`. Proposed conversion in PR: `tracehook: { trace_key: "", span_sampling: { strategy: "probabilistic", rate: 0.02 } }`
tia: good. Also update the heatmap metric name from `latency_p95` -> `latency.p95` for v2. Add a one-line migration note: "span_sampling changed from bool to object; empty trace_key should be an empty string."
emily: I updated the PR with those diffs and added a testing checklist to manually render the example locally. Left a comment about the SDK snippets still using `cost_per_token` (should be `unit_cost.tokens`).
ryan: I'll patch the link and add a tiny fix for the legend note. Please add docs-owner review @tia @sam.
tia: reviewing now. left one nit about wording around `cost_mode`.
emily: fixed wording, pushed. CI re-run queued.
ci-bot: CI re-run triggered by @emily. All example renders pass locally.
emily: merging after approvals. Post-merge: open follow-ups REDW-1207 (sweep SDK snippets for cost field rename) and REDW-1206 (infra redirect). Thanks :rocket:
